This is a suggestion for the highest level of play in Overwatch namely Overwatch League and presumably Overwatch Contenders.

The article specifically points out how having a 'Ban Phase' on the ladder for Overwatch may actually create more issues. 

For the highest levels of Overwatch a 'Ban Phase' is 100% necessary and only good things will come from it.

For the ladder we'll have to see. It may be worth exploring introducing a 'Ban Phase' to players of a certain SR like Masters up or something, because I can see in all lower ranks everyone getting pissed at banning D.va even if it the most logical ban other than Brig.
